# Emergency Department Procedures
title: Emergency

content:
> Note: This is synthetic demo data for the Smart Hospital Management System. > This does not represent a real hospital. # Emergency Department Procedures

- **When to visit ER**: Severe bleeding, chest pain, breathing difficulty, loss of consciousness, severe trauma, sudden weakness or numbness.
- **Triage Process**: Upon arrival, patients are assessed (triaged) based on severity. Critical cases (Emergency/High) are treated immediately regardless of arrival time.
- **What to bring**: Identification, insurance details, current medications list.
- **Contact**: In case of life-threatening emergencies requiring an ambulance, call our emergency hotline: 555-0911.

- **Private Rooms**: 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily. Only two visitors allowed per patient at a time.
- **ICU/CCU**: 11:00 AM to 11:30 AM and 5:00 PM to 5:30 PM daily. Only one family member allowed per patient. No children under 12 allowed.

We provide comprehensive medical services:
- **Emergency**: 24/7 care for urgent medical issues, accidents, and trauma.
- **OPD (Outpatient Department)**: Scheduled consultations with specialists.
- **IPD (Inpatient Department)**: Hospitalization and round-the-clock nursing care.
- **Diagnostic Services**: X-Rays, MRI, CT Scans, Ultrasound, Pathology Lab.
- **Pharmacy**: In-house 24/7 pharmacy for all prescription needs.
- **Ambulance**: 24/7 transport services.

title: Appointments

content:
> Note: This is synthetic demo data for the Smart Hospital Management System. > This does not represent a real hospital. # Appointments Policy

- **Booking**: Appointments can be booked through our online portal, via phone at 555-0100, or in-person at the OPD reception.
- **Cancellation**: Please cancel at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a no-show fee.
- **Rescheduling**: Can be done up to 12 hours before the appointment.
- **No-Show Policy**: Three consecutive no-shows may lead to a temporary restriction on online booking.
- **Wait Times**: Please arrive 15 minutes before your scheduled slot. Walk-in patients will be seen based on availability after scheduled patients.
